environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override set to COUNT (not block), (2) A custom rule with priority 1 that uses a RegexPatternSet matching field 'AllQueryArguments' against pattern '(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|--\s|/\*|\*/|char\(|concat\(|0x[0-9a-f]+|\x27|%27)' with action BLOCK, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default BLOCK action. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm both custom rule and managed SQLi rule set are actively evaluating and blocking requests. The ALB performs query string inspection before forwarding to the target group.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAF v2 WebACL
